# PodVM schema

The schema is copied from prem-research/podvm commit
`b57d5e92583388169743bc0084673f0249d64a34` (release v0.1.6):
https://github.com/prem-research/podvm/blob/b57d5e92583388169743bc0084673f0249d64a34/schemas/measurements.schema.json

It is vendored so remote schemas cannot redefine the supported input contract.
Update it together with compatibility tests when the PodVM format changes.
